Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: The plan includes an inventory of all district facilities with basic details such as school locations and capacities (Section IV, Tables 2 and 3), but lacks detailed site plans, square footage of classrooms, or comprehensive condition assessments of building systems.

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: The plan provides a comprehensive enrollment analysis with detailed methodology including student generation factors, birth rates, cohort survival factors, and multiple projection scenarios (Sections V-VIII, Tables 4-32). It links enrollment projections to capacity needs and specific facility actions including new school construction and boundary adjustments.

Educational Alignment.justification: There is no mention or discussion of educational goals, educational specifications, or how facilities align with instructional needs or programs in the provided content.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: The plan does not reference outdoor spaces, greening, shade, or outdoor learning in the provided content.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: No mention of climate risks, climate readiness, or mitigation strategies is found in the provided content.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: There is no mention of energy efficiency, electrification, decarbonization, or energy resilience strategies in the provided content.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: The plan includes cost estimates for new facilities and discusses timing and phasing of school construction (Section X), but lacks detailed financial planning, prioritization criteria, or comprehensive funding strategies.
